member.summary:
Canonical byte layout of the binary Addressables catalog (catalog.bin), mirrored from Unity's ContentCatalogData.ResourceLocator and AssetBundleRequestOptionsSerializationAdapter.
The catalog is written by Unity's BinaryStorageBuffer: an append-only, hash-deduplicated blob of little-endian values. Every field below is an absolute byte offset into that blob, so the obfuscator can locate and patch a bundle CRC in place without re-serializing the whole catalog.

member.name: T:GUPS.Assets.Editor.Files.Web.UnityWebCompression
member.summary: Compression helpers producing gzip / brotli streams the way the Unity WebGL build pipeline does. Unity embeds a marker comment ("UnityWeb Compressed Content (gzip)" as gzip FCOMMENT, "UnityWeb Compressed Content (brotli)" as a leading brotli metadata meta-block) into its compressed web files. The Unity web loader (UnityLoader.js, hasUnityMarker) only decompresses a file in JavaScript (the "Decompression Fallback") if this marker is present. Without it, a file served without a matching Content-Encoding response header is treated as uncompressed and fails to load. Therefore the written files must carry the same marker as the originals.
